    Description
    AbstractTool
    Base for every Tool: no-op gesture handlers, a crosshair cursor and a runtime-drawn icon keyed by the tool name.
    BrushTool
    A soft, antialiased freehand brush that honours the tool's stroke width, opacity and foreground colour.
    EllipseTool
    Ellipse inscribed in the dragged rectangle; filled and/or stroked.
    EraserTool
    Freehand eraser.
    EyedropperTool
    Eyedropper (colour picker).
    FillTool
    Flood fill (paint bucket).
    FilterDialog
    A reusable live-preview adjustments dialog.
    FilterDialog.FilterFactory
    Builds a filter from the current slider values (keyed by param key).
    FilterDialog.Param
    One labelled integer slider.
    FreeformTool
    Freeform (lasso-draw) shape.
    FreehandTool
    Shared behaviour of the freehand tools (brush, pencil, eraser, spray).
    ImageOps
    Pure-java.awt.image pixel transforms and filters for the Paint app - geometry (scale, crop, rotate, flip) and adjustments (brightness/contrast, grayscale, invert, hue/saturation, posterize, threshold, blur, sharpen, emboss).
    ImageOps.Filter
    A whole-image adjustment/transform.
    LayerPanel
    The right-hand layer stack: a JList of layers (topmost first) with live thumbnails, a visibility box, an opacity slider and a blend-mode combo for the active layer, plus add/delete/duplicate/merge/reorder buttons.
    LineTool
    Straight line dragged from an anchor to the release point.
    NewImageDialog
    The File → New dialog: canvas width/height and a background colour.
    PaintApp
    Entry point for the Paint app.
    PaintCanvas
    The drawing surface.
    PaintContext
    Everything a Tool needs while it works: the PaintDocument, the PaintState tool settings, the current Selection, and a PaintContext.Callback back to PaintCanvas for repaints, dialogs and selection notifications.
    PaintContext.Callback
    The canvas-side services a tool may call.
    PaintDocument
    The Paint document model: an ordered stack of PaintLayers over a background colour, a cached composite for fast repaint, structural editing (add/delete/reorder/duplicate/merge/flatten), whole-image transforms (resize/crop/rotate/flip) and a bounded undo history.
    PaintDocument.Listener
    Notified whenever the document changes so the UI can repaint/refresh.
    PaintDocument.Snapshot
    An immutable deep copy of the whole document, for snapshot edits.
    PaintFrame
    The Paint application window: a conventional JFrame with a full menu bar (File / Edit / Image / Layer / Select / View / Filter / Help), a tool + options toolbar, the PaintCanvas in a scroll pane, the LayerPanel on the right and a StatusBar at the bottom.
    PaintIcons
    Runtime-drawn toolbox icons.
    PaintIO
    File I/O for the Paint app: Open / Save / Save-As through a JFileChooser backed by ImageIO for PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP.
    PaintLayer
    A single raster layer of a PaintDocument: an ARGB BufferedImage plus the presentation attributes the compositor honours (name, visibility, opacity and blend mode).
    PaintLayer.BlendMode
    How a layer's pixels combine with what is already beneath it.
    PaintState
    The mutable tool settings shared by every Tool: the active tool, foreground/background colours, stroke geometry, tool opacity, font, shape fill/stroke flags, flood-fill tolerance, zoom and the antialiasing switch.
    PencilTool
    A hard-edged, single-pixel freehand pencil.
    PolygonTool
    Click-to-place polygon.
    RectangleTool
    Axis-aligned rectangle dragged out corner to corner; filled and/or stroked.
    ResizeDialog
    The Image → Resize dialog: a new pixel width/height with an optional keep-aspect-ratio lock.
    RotateDialog
    The Image → Rotate dialog: quick 90/180/-90 presets and an arbitrary angle spinner.
    Selection
    A document-space selection: an axis-aligned bounding Rectangle plus an optional per-pixel mask.
    SelectLassoTool
    Freeform (lasso) selection.
    SelectRectTool
    Rectangular marquee selection.
    ShapeTool
    Base for the drag-out two-point shapes (line, rectangle, ellipse).
    SprayTool
    An airbrush: each gesture event scatters a burst of single-pixel dots at random within a circular spray whose radius follows the tool's stroke width.
    StatusBar
    The bottom status strip: pointer coordinates, zoom percentage, document size and a hint for the active tool.
    TextDialog
    The text-entry dialog opened by TextTool.
    TextTool
    Text tool.
    Tool
    A Paint tool.
    Toolbox
    The vertical tool palette: one toggle button per Tool, laid out in two columns with runtime-drawn icons and hint tooltips.
    Toolbox.Listener
    Notified when the user picks a different tool.
